evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Our empirical evaluations demonstrate the framework's efficacy across both synthetic and realistic benchmarks, showing (1) experience gains acquired within simpler sub-environments can be effectively composed to improve performance in the full one, and (2) test-time training on sub-environments can significantly enhance the compositional generalization of agents in real-world web automation tasks.
